notes.title: Update V4.0.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Hope you're all doing good.

We've released yet another small update for the prologue version of Bullet Runner, which includes numerous AI improvements, menu / UI overhauls, and audio improvements (most notably reverb volumes in the levels to reflect the environments).

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update V3.0.0
notes.content:
[b]Intro[/b]

Hey everyone! As we're nearing the release of the full game, we wanted to update the prologue version to better reflect the full product. This update includes a bunch of improvements across the board, as well as implementing some new features based on user feedback.

Let us know what you think!


[b]Additions[/b]

[list]
[*]Added a new starter skill (Power Kick), which causes explosions to erupt when you kick an enemy
[*]Added collectable toys that you can view in the level select menu
[*]Added waypoint feature. Press down on the d-pad (or Q on the keyboard) to display a waypoint marker to help you if you ever get lost in a level
[*]Added tilt-shift visual camera effect, which can be toggled from the graphics menu
[*]Added Vsync
[*]Cutscene SFX
[/list]


[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*]Rebalanced difficulty
[*]Reduced amount of extra life pickups throughout levels
[*]Removed anti motion sickness mode, as it was not achieving the intended effect, and was causing multiple issues
[*]Smoother transition from menu to load game / new game
[*]Camera view + FOV adjusted to make the 2D / 3D blend mesh better
[*]Fine tuned screen shake
[*]Balanced audio levels
[/list]


[b]Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*]Massively improved performance across the board, especially for low - mid spec systems
[*]Enemy path finding
[/list]

notes.title: The First Slaughter is now over
notes.content:
Thank you all tens of thousands of magnificent players for the enthusiasm and feedback you gave us through The First Slaughter! 

We are soon getting closer to the release of the full game and thus we wanted to update The First Slaughter to include only a short, very sneaky peek of the game. The First Slaughter is and especially was a free preview or a prologue of the upcoming full game, and we do not want to reveal too much anymore.

Support the game and make it fly to the Mars by wishlisting it! 

Warmly,
Kami Games

notes.title: Update V2.3.2
notes.content:
[b]Intro[/b]

Hey everyone! Based on some feedback, we've released a new patch that makes some minor balance changes to the weapons in the game, as well as some bug fixes and a new feature! Check it out below.


[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Quick swap: you can now instantly swap between your last two guns by tapping the weapon reel button (can be changed in the keybind settings)
[*]Added a button to remove specific keybinds to the keybind menu
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Shotgun now has slightly increased fire rate
[*]Rocket launcher now has slightly increased fire rate
[*]Sniper now has slightly increased fire rate
[/list]

Bug fixes
[list]
[*]Removed a UI shader that was causing performance dips and visual artifacting
[/list]

notes.title: Update V2.3.1
notes.content:
[b]Intro[/b]

Hey everyone! Thanks again for all the amazing feedback you gave us while trying out Bullet Runner: The First Slaughter. We've tried to incorporate you're complaints, ideas and feedback into improving the game as a whole. Here are the most important new things in this latest update:

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Volumetric fog
[*]Super resolution
[*]Brightness slider
[*]Gameplay tips & tricks
[*]Added power buff drinks, which can be picked up to get a short power-boost in a certain stat (speed/damage/finisher cooldown)
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Machine gun now deals less damage, but has higher accuracy
[*]Rocket launcher now deals less damage, but dazes enemies on direct hit, and staggers enemies on AOE hit
[*]Plasma rifle now deals less damage, but slows enemies down way faster
[*]Removed checkpoint portal visual
[*]Changed saving system to an async solution (mitigates the massive lag spike we had on saving prior)
[*]Smoothed out the difficulty curve throughout the levels
[*]Made easy and normal difficulty modes a bit more accessible / easy
[*]Enemies can now be knocked into pits
[*]Redesigned a lot of arena environments to be more spacious and more fun with more movement options
[*]When you die right after performing a kick, you'll get healed up instantly and can now continue the fight
[*]Reduced health of Heavies
[*]Increased speed of Heavies
[*]Removed ability for player to chain pull heavy class enemies
[*]Changed the way chain swinging works with mouse input according to user feedback
[*]You can now break enemy shields by shooting at them (besides chain-pulling)
[*]Removed some arenas to reduce action overload in levels
[*]Added new rooms and spaces to existing levels
[*]Added more 'ambient' enemies to existing levels (that aren't part of an arena, but just walk around)
[*]Added new artwork and lighting changes to existing levels
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Forgot to keep track after so many .. figure out for yourself will ya!
[/list]

As always, thanks for playing, and keep the feedback coming!

Take care everyone,
Laura - Lead Designer

notes.title: We need your help!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

Again, we want to thank you all for playing The Last Slaughter. As we're always looking for new ways to improve the game and make it as fun as possible, we decided to ask our community for some help!

[b]We have one simple question to ask you: 'At what point did you stop playing the game, and why?'[/b]

This can include (but is not limited to):
[list]
[*]Encountering a game-breaking bug
[*]The game was too hard
[*]The story wasn't progressing fast enough
[*]I simply didn't like the gameplay
[*]Etc ..
[/list]

By knowing where certain hick-ups are located in the experience, we can fine-tune things and make it better.

Thanks for reading, and we're looking forward to your replies!

notes.title: Score system & enemy improvements!
notes.content:
[b]Intro[/b]
Hey everyone! We want to thank you all for playing The First Slaughter, and for the massive amount of downloads we've reached so far. You're all awesome!

We've just released a small update for the game that fixes numerous issues regarding enemy behaviours and movement, as well as improve their intelligence and behaviour on those fronts. On top of that, we've included the first iteration of the score system into the game. You'll now be able to settle a score for every level in the game, and break your own high-scores!

Check out the new score system in action! (in the bottom right of the screen)
[previewyoutube=LU-AOKwPbjA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Change log[/b]
- Fixed Heavies jumping out of the play space
- Fixed Mechanics getting stuck in corners
- Fixed a bug where pressing the back button while in the pause menu would change the games difficulty
- Fixed a bug where killing enemies before the arena they were in got triggered would soft-lock the game
- Improved fleeing behaviour for the Scientist and Mechanic
- Implemented the first iteration of the score system
